item.title: Solving Flaky Playwright Tests: How We Automated E2E Generation with an AI Agent and MCP

item.title: Your coding agent's sandbox is off. Here's how to turn it on without breaking everything.
item.description: After an hour you either turn the sandbox off or add broad rules ("allow all of ~") that quietly undo it. That is the important lesson for anyone configuring a sandbox: the dangerous permission isn't "write anywhere", it's "write to a file something else will execute later".
